brief: A cover to hide the cables behind my TV and keep them tidy.

requirements.requirement: A cover that hides the cables behind the TV
requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases in a row (piece:-1,0,0, 0,0,0, 1,0,0) each closed with a top cover set to cable type (cover:...;full;top), end faces capped by capOpenFaces and joints bolted by lockJoints, forming a ~505mm long enclosed spine the cables run inside, shown staged with two cable-coil props.

requirements.requirement: Keep the cables tidy / organised inside
requirements.evidence: A cable comb (hex-acc-comb) fitted in each of the three cells (accessory:0#-1,0#2, 0#0,0#2, 0#1,0#2) to separate runs, plus hex-port-gland cable plates at both ends and mid-cell (port:0#-1,0#5, 0#1,0#0, 0#0,0#1) so each cable enters/leaves through a drawn opening.

requirements.requirement: Sized / mounted for a specific TV, wall or heat/material constraints
requirements.evidence: No TV size, mounting, or material was specified; the build is a freestanding 505x366x80mm unit. The configurator checks fit only and knows nothing about materials, heat or load, so suitability for a particular TV or hot equipment cannot be claimed.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell enclosed cable spine (~505mm long) to sit behind a TV: three full hex bases joined and bolted, each topped with a cable-type cover, open end faces capped, a cable comb inside each cell to separate runs, and cable-gland port plates at both ends and the middle for tidy entry/exit. Staged with two coiled cables on top. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no issues.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
